test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. Most of these superpowers are not rich in natural resources and have faced political turmoil.

B. Human capital ultimately makes the difference, both, in an enterprise and a nation.

C. The new economic superpowers of today amply testify to this thesis.

D. Yet, they have achieved economic affluence in a relatively short period.
solution:
The correct answer is 'BCAD.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence 'B' is independent of any other sentence as it is introducing or giving general information about "**Human capital**". Hence, 'B' is the first part.
 
• Sentence C will come after B as it is saying that the** ****new economic superpowers amply testify to human capital**.
 
• Sentence A will come after C as it is giving information about the superpowers i.e they are not rich in natural resources and have faced** ****political turmoil**.
 
• The sentence 'D' is the concluding part as it further explains in spite of the turmoils the superpowers have achieved economic affluence.

 

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: *Human capital ultimately makes the difference, both, in an enterprise and a nation. The new economic superpowers of today amply testify to this thesis. Most of these superpowers are not rich in natural resources and have faced political turmoil. Yet, they have achieved economic affluence in a relatively short period.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__**

__
 
• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__:

 
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.
